def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Copy the known panel into each equal-sized panel separated by color 4 lines.
    hs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 4 for x in row)]
    vs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + hs + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vs + [w]
    panels = [(rbounds[i]+1, rbounds[i+1], cbounds[j]+1, cbounds[j+1])
              for i in range(len(rbounds)-1) for j in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    # Locate non-background panel as the source.
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    src = next((p for p in panels if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(p[0],p[1]) for c in range(p[2],p[3]))), None)
    if src is None: return out
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = src
    for a,b,x,y in panels:
        if (a,b,x,y)==src or (b-a!=r1-r0) or (y-x!=c1-c0): continue
        for r in range(b-a):
            for c in range(y-x): out[a+r][x+c] = grid[r0+r][c0+c]
    return out
PY
